Container.Name: netlens
Container.Overview:
NetLens — a self-hosted dashboard for UniFi networks.
• Usage per device and app, with time charts • Sites each device visited, by category • Devices: presence, rename, block • Wi-Fi signal, roaming and failed joins • Blocked traffic and intrusions, ads apart • Daily alerts per app and device
Keeps 30 days of detail and 90 days of events, well beyond UniFi's own. Needs a UniFi OS console and a local API key. Not affiliated with Ubiquiti.
Container.Requires: A UniFi OS console reachable from this server, and a local API key (UniFi Network > Settings > Control Plane > Integrations > Create API Key).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the dashboard in your browser.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Cache, settings and logs. Keep it on appdata so updates never lose history.

Config.Name: Syslog TCP
Config.Description: Optional: for blocked-ad counts. Turn the listener on in the app (Settings, port 5514).

Config.Name: Syslog UDP
Config.Description: Optional: for blocked-ad counts. Turn the listener on in the app (Settings, port 5514).
